Subject: Sponsorship credit request for CloudForge accelerator cohort

Hi Camila,

Hope you're well — CloudForge is kicking off our next enterprise accelerator (cohort starts mid‑June) and we have two joint prospects that would convert quickly if we can offer Redwood promotional credits as part of the package.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider allocating $40,000 in promotional credits (to be applied as usage credit on our reseller marketplace invoices) plus a 90‑day trial extension for Fathom Health? The cohort terms are 6 months and we expect them to hit production in Q4. We can provide a joint case study commitment and a logo placement in exchange.

I've attached a completed sponsor form (cloudforge_sponsor_form.pdf) and a short note with the expected timelines. If it helps, Tara (CC) is the buyer and can confirm the timing.

Would appreciate a quick internal route to approvals — happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge Labs
Anita@cloudforge.com

I'll start an approval thread internally; if we get alignment on these items we can aim to approve by early next week.

Thanks for looping me in. Legal quick notes:
1) We'll need a signed sponsor agreement from CloudForge acknowledging: (a) credits are promotional, (b) non-refundable, (c) tracking obligations, (d) correct beneficiary (CloudForge vs end customer). I attached our standard sponsor agreement (redwood_sponsor_agreement_v1.pdf) as a starting point.
2) For marketplace/reseller-sponsored credits > $50k we require Finance sign-off. At $40k this falls under Channel approval but we still need the filled tracking sheet and HubSpot deal id.
3) For marketplace transactions where credits are passed through to a third party, include the end‑customer name and a customer contact (Tara at Fathom Health is fine). Legal will also need the DocuSign envelope once the sponsor agreement is returned.

If CloudForge can return a signed sponsor agreement and the filled promo_tracking-sheet by EOD Monday, we can issue the credits the following week.

Neha Kapoor
